title: Music bed record
description: A record in music/<bed_id>.json. To a track what videos/<video_id>.json is to a source video: provenance plus measurements, never the media. Until 2026-08-13 bed records had no schema at all, so tools/bed.py's free-text --usage-class was never checked against vocab/provenance.yaml -- the same class of drift tests/test_index_integrity.py exists to catch for segments and videos.

bed_id.description: Stable identifier, referenced by a shotlist's `bed` field.

media_filename.description: The file in media/, which is gitignored. The record travels; the audio never does.

usage_class.description: Rights bucket, and it must agree with vocab/provenance.yaml -- tests assert the two match. `cc_by_4_0` means the licence already permits this use and attribution is the only condition; it is a record that the asset is CLEARED, which is the thing this index previously could not say.

source_rights_note.description: Human-readable rights note. For cc_by_4_0 it must say where the mandatory credit is reproduced.

attribution.description: The credit string the licence requires, reproduced verbatim. Required for cc_by_4_0. This is reproduced copy, not authored copy: the licensor specifies the wording, so it is never paraphrased, reformatted or shortened.

excisions.description: Bar-snapped sections removed from the track, in source time.

anchors.description: Named moments in the track, preferred over literal timecodes in a builder.

source_format.description: The delivery rung the audio came from, when it matters -- see the audio-quality-tenet skill.
